title: A colour mixer
description:
Work with colours as numbers.

```
Colour 1: #FF8800
Colour 2: #0088FF
RGB 1: (255, 136, 0)
RGB 2: (0, 136, 255)
Mixed 50/50: #808880
Grey version of colour 1: #9C9C9C
```
hints: `colour[1:3]`, `colour[3:5]` and `colour[5:7]` are the three hex pairs (lesson 3.04).
requirements: Mix two colours by averaging each channel (round to the nearest whole number).
Make a grey with the weights 0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B.
